key_insight: PATS turns skills into a policy-aware training scaffold that adapts rollout context as the agent improves, helping weak long-horizon LLM policies learn more effectively.
engineering_relevance: For agentic RL systems, it offers a practical way to improve exploration and training stability with task-specific guidance during training while removing that scaffolding at deployment.
method: Convert rollout groups from the latest policy into evidence cards.
Use task-specific evaluation to revise, reduce, or remove contextual guidance over time.
Train the policy with environmental rewards via standard RLVR, then discard the scaffold at deployment.
evidence_signal: The method reports up to 18.6% gains on ALFWorld and WebShop, and stays competitive on seven search-augmented QA benchmarks while using 32.1% fewer prompt tokens than the baseline.
watch_item: Because the scaffold is task-specific and dynamically managed, its effectiveness may depend on reliable evaluation signals and careful context pruning to avoid over-reliance or loss of useful guidance.
paper_title: PATS: Policy-Aware Training Scaffolding for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
